name: 89451 · Incline Vlg, NV
findings: ZIP 89451 (Incline Vlg) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89451 (Incline Vlg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
